llm._comment: One model per agent, matched to the job. Throughput figures are Nebius Token Factory's published Tok/s — Llama-3.3-70B (25 Tok/s) was the original bottleneck.

SCHEMA_MD._why: 70 Tok/s. INSTRUCT (non-thinking) variant - agent_rocketride requires strict JSON from its LLM, and reasoning models that narrate first are rejected by the engine after 4 retries. Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking would fail here; the Instruct one does not.

DUPLICATE_MD._why: 351 Tok/s, 1M context. Fuzzy duplicate grouping needs every row in view at once.

ANOMALY_MD._why: 351 Tok/s. Proven to return clean JSON under agent_rocketride in live runs; GLM-5.3-Flash narrated and was rejected.

CHIEF._why: 523 Tok/s, tuned for multi-agent + complex reasoning. Conflict arbitration is the hardest call in the system; runs once per run so cost is bounded. NOTE: regional endpoint.

hotdata._comment: Flip to true once the Hotdata half is ready. When false the specialists analyse the data slice passed in the question context and the harness uses the mock telemetry sink. When true the generator wires one db_hotdata node per specialist (its own isolated ephemeral DB) and the pipeline performs create -> query -> destroy natively.
hotdata._sink_comment: Separate from `enabled`. `enabled` wires db_hotdata INTO the pipeline (ephemeral, per-run, engine-managed). This flag switches the HOST-SIDE persistent telemetry sink to RealHotdata, which is the teammate's unimplemented half. Leave false until RealHotdata.log_event exists.
